mapper.select: SELECT s.code_value value_code, s.MEANING value_name FROM sys_code_value_b_v s WHERE s.CODE = #{code} ORDER BY s.ORDER_SEQ

SELECT t.price_list value_code, t.description value_name FROM hls_PRICE_LIST t WHERE T.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND t.PRICE_LIST IN ( 'GECALCULATOR_PMT_JC', 'GECALCULATOR_LP_JC', 'GECALCULATOR_CASUAL_JC' ) ORDER BY T.DESCRIPTION DESC

SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT v.code_value_id AS tree_node_id, v.code_value_id, v.code_value AS value_code, v.MEANING AS value_name, v.parent_code_value_id AS parent_tree_node_id, v.MEANING AS tree_node_desc, ( CASE WHEN v.CODE = 'HLS200.APPLY_LEASING_PRODUCT' THEN '' ELSE 'N' END ) expand_flag FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE V.CODE IN ( 'HLS200.LEASING_PRODUCT_DETAIL', 'HLS200.APPLY_LEASING_PRODUCT' ) AND FIND_IN_SET( v.code_value_id, getChildList ( v.code_value_id ) ) ORDER BY code_id ) t
SELECT t.tax_type_code AS value_code, t.description AS value_name, t.tax_type_rate AS vat_rate FROM fnd_tax_type_code t WHERE t.TAX_TYPE_CODE IN ('VAT_OUT_13', 'VAT_OUT_6') AND t.enabled_flag = 'Y'
